candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] NKG2D-based CAR T-cells (other names: KD-025 CAR T-cells): Autologous genetically modified anti-NKG2DLs CAR transduced T cells

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the safety and clinical activity of NKG2D-based CAR-T cells infusion in the treatment of relapsed/refractory NKG2DL+ solid tumors.

role_evidence.quote: Autologous genetically modified anti-NKG2DLs CAR transduced T cells

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous NKG2D-based CAR T-cell therapy (KD-025); cell therapy

source_quote.quote: Patient with NKG2DL+ cell tumors confirmed by pathology and histology

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket (HCC, glioblastoma, medulloblastoma, colon cancer) testing NKG2D CAR-T cells, an excluded intervention type; no pharmacological candidate. NKG2DL+ is an entry requirement mechanistically linked to the CAR-T, but CAR-T is not a candidate so candidate_matched false. The single registered arm label is literally 'Arms'. CAR copy number in peripheral blood is a cell-therapy expansion measure, not drug PK. No conditioning chemotherapy is described.
